DeepSeek Harness 插件：当本地试错成本升高时，自动注入检索提示，引导 Agent 查阅文档或联网搜索。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-research-nudge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An advisory **research-debt guard** for DeepSeek Harness. It notices when an agent spends a long str"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"etch reading, editing, executing, and repeating failures without consulting external evidence, then "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"adds a short reminder to the next model step."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It does not call an LLM, perform a search, block a tool, or force the agent to browse. The reminder "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"explicitly allows self-contained work to continue normally."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Agents sometimes fall into a local trial-and-error loop:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A search of the official docs, an exact error message, or an existing GitHub issue may resolve that "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"uncertainty faster. `dsh-research-nudge` turns the growing cost of the local loop into a determinist"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ic score called **Research Debt**."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Research Debt: a calculated example"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"This is a hypothetical sequence calculated from the documented default weights, not production telem"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"etry. It shows exactly how the score would cross the threshold:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Step | Signal | Added debt | Total |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Read local code | ordinary tool"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" | +1 | 1 |
| Edit a file | mutation | +2 | 3 |
| Run and fail | execution + failure | +1 +4 | 8 |
|"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" Edit again | mutation | +2 | 10 |
| Run and hit the equivalent failure again | execution + failure "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"+ repeated failure | +1 +4 +6 | **21** |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The default threshold is 20, so the last result carries an additional model-visible context:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Equivalent failures are fingerprinted after normalizing changing numbers and addresses, so `TypeErro"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"r at line 123` and `TypeError at line 456` count as a repeat. A recognized research tool resets the "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"accumulated state for that agent."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Prerequisites:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7` (the current `next` release line)
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`"},{"id":"p18s2","text":", matching the current DSH baseline"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From GitHub:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Git installs run this package's `prepare` build. pnpm may reject that build until you explicitly tru"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"st it. Follow the exact `allowBuilds` entry printed by DSH/pnpm, review the source first, and pin a "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"tag or commit for reproducible installs:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"After the package is published to npm, the prebuilt install is:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Verify the composed layer, then restart the profile:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Local development install"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Relative paths are resolved from the directory where `dsh plugin` is invoked."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Default policy"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Signal | Debt |
| --- | ---: |
| Ordinary tool call | +1 |
| File mutation | +2 |
| Shell/build/te"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"st execution | +1 |
| Failed tool result | +4 |
| Repeated equivalent failure | +6 |
| Recognized ex"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ternal research tool | reset to 0 |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"A reminder is eligible when any condition is met:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Research Debt reaches 20;
- 15 tool calls occur without recognized research; or
- 15 minutes pass "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"without recognized research."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"After a reminder, the per-agent state continues accumulating but further reminders are suppressed fo"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"r 10 minutes. Names are normalized before classification and research matching, so `WebSearch`, `web"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"_search`, and `web-search` are treated consistently."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Agent snooze"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"An agent that is deliberately making progress from local evidence can call the model-visible `resear"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ch_nudge_snooze` tool to suppress reminders for a while (defaults to 30 minutes, capped by `maxAgent"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" tool to suppress reminders for a while (defaults to 30 minutes, capped by `maxAgentSnoozeMinutes`):"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Snoozing is **per agent** — other agents keep their own schedules.
- Research Debt keeps accumulat"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ing while snoozed: snoozing neither counts as research nor erases debt or failure counters. Once the"},{"id":"p37s3","text":" snooze expires, an already-eligible state nudges on the next tool call.
- A failed snooze call (for"},{"id":"p37s4","text":" example, invalid arguments rejected by schema validation) arms nothing and is recorded as an ordina"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ry failed call. Snooze executions bypass research recognition entirely, so a custom `researchTools` "},{"id":"p37s6","text":"pattern such as `search` (which substring-matches the snooze tool's own name) can never turn a faile"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"d snooze into a debt reset."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The bundle inserts a row with the id `research-nudge`. | `debtThreshold` | `20` | Debt score that "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"makes a reminder eligible |
| `maxToolCallsWithoutResearch` | `15` | Call-count fallback threshold |"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"
| `maxMinutesWithoutResearch` | `15` | Elapsed-time fallback threshold |
| `cooldownMinutes` | `10`"},{"id":"p43s4","text":" | Minimum time between reminders |
| `ordinaryToolDebt` | `1` | Weight for other local tools |

DSH is still a Developer Preview and explicitly allows compatibility"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"-breaking changes. If a later DSH release changes the tool waterfall or message contract, update the"},{"id":"p45s4","text":" small adapter in `src/index.ts`; the deterministic policy in `src/policy.ts` is independent."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## Privacy and safety"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"- No telemetry, network requests, API keys, or extra model calls.
- No tool arguments are stored or "},{"id":"p47s2","text":"copied.
- The in-memory fingerprint uses only failed-result text; it is not persisted.
- The reminde"},{"id":"p47s3","text":"r is advisory and never changes a tool result or permission decision.
- Git installs execute a local"},{"id":"p47s4","text":" build script; review and pin third-party code before allowing it."}],"truncated":true}
